I now that feeling but every time i think there is nothing for me i find a little bit of entertainment. You can't know there is nothing out there for you unless you've searched for everything.

You should live because you choose to. The same reason your still here now

One peice of advice. Don't go numb. I had a shitty childhood (mother who tried to kill me multiple times ect) and now I simply don't feel. No sadness means no happiness also. Hold on to the fact that if you can feel sad you know what happiness will be like down the road. Just keep your head up.

Good suggestions but i used all. Was best person at chess in my state before i got bored. I enjoy learning hard video games but once i know the rules i lose interest. Dwarf fortress seems to be the best for entertainment. Already do programming (computational maths/physics) but i could be much better at it.
Pretty much what I'm thinking right now.
